findings.claim: “Confidence loops skip missing answers similarly” and unqualified missing/empty/error-skip wording obscure distinct scoring vs calibration failure behavior.
findings.observed: score_items guards absent system/qid, then pred returns None for None/error and skips. Calibration main guards only absent system/qid, then evaluates pred and conf together. conf has no None/error guard: None at an existing qid raises on indexing/.get; a noul error/empty object can KeyError before the p-is-not-None check. Thus score_items skip behavior does not guarantee full report/calibration safely skips the same answer. Empty/malformed per-question noul answer is not normalized by pred either. Existing safe fixture tests pred and synthesized denominator, not this calibration path.

Documentation-only correction; do not repair report code in this task.
